messages:
alex: quick flag  canary in eu-west shows lots of fncall validation failures that are not tagged with route_id. Billing and quota views show these as "unattributed". anyone digging in?

jordan: I noticed gaps too. The validation service emits error metrics but the route enrich step seems skipped sometimes. Could be a short-circuit in the new streaming validator.

sam: I reproduced. If the request payload causes the streaming parser to error, we abort before the route-binding middleware runs. That explains missing route_id.

maria: impact: customers see quota surprises; support tickets already. We also can't surface useful rows in Console since route filter yields nothing. Need a quick attribution shim.

alex: pragmatic fix: emit a tiny telemetry blob on validation failures before aborting. Fields: reason_code (enum), stage (enum), route_hint_hash (fixed64), safe_tag (optional, opt-in). No freeform error text.

jordan: prefer route_hint_hash instead of plain route id to reduce cardinality and avoid PII leakage. Also require that safe_tag is explicit from config and cannot contain user-supplied content.

sam: implementation notes: current telemetry aggregator truncates long strings and drops unknown keys. Keep envelope <= 128 bytes. Proposed envelope: 
``` 
{ "reason_code": "UNPARSEABLE_JSON", "stage":"parser", "route_hint_hash":"a1b2c3d4", "safe_tag": "billing:team-a" } 
```
We will serialize compactly and mark as sampled.

maria: Console UX: add an "Unattributed Validation" quick-filter and a small heatmap showing reason_code distribution and top hashed route_hints (with human map when available). For samples, only show redacted payloads and only for orgs that opt-in.

lee: security reminder: any sample storage needs automatic redaction (PII scrubber) and a retention of max 7 days unless enterprise opts in. Also audit logs for who views samples.

alex: good point. Also finance: confirm that adding safe_tag won't retroactively change billing. It should be metadata-only.

ops-bot: Note: telemetry fields that affect billing require FIN sign-off. See policy FIN-telemetry-1.

jordan: cardinality control: route_hint_hash should be 8 hex chars (32-bit) to keep indexed space small. We can maintain a map of known route ids -> human labels in Console. Unknown entries remain hashed.

sam: prod change plan: 1) emit envelope in canary only, 2) verify it reaches observability pipeline (no truncation), 3) enable Console filter behind FF. If healthy for 48h, roll further.

maria: I'll prepare a support playbook note explaining what "Unattributed Validation" means and how to request map entries for enterprise customers.

alex: tests: sam, add e2e that simulates parser error and asserts telemetry blob emitted and present in the pipeline. jordan, wire mockups. lee, draft redaction checklist.

sam: will add test and check batching behavior so tiny envelope isn't dropped. Also ensure it doesn't cause backpressure on telemetry queue.

jordan: mockups incoming by EOD. Sketch will show heatmap + top hashes + optional mapping modal.

ops-bot: Actions created: TG-1301 (emit validation envelope), UX-780 (console unattributed-filter mockups), SEC-415 (sample redaction + audit).

alex: thanks all. If anyone finds a case where the route binding actually ran but telemetry still missing, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
